tracks.title: Contemplation
tracks.creator: Joth
tracks.notes: Ambience without a real melody (the creator's description).

tracks.title: Calm Ambient 1 (Synthwave 4k)
tracks.creator: The Cynic Project (cynicmusic)
tracks.notes: Calm pads and soothing chords; the build-up and ending are left out.

tracks.title: Rising Moon
tracks.creator: RandomMind
tracks.notes: A mystical, windy-night fantasy piece; the intro and ending are left out.

tracks.title: Lament for a Warrior's Soul
tracks.creator: RandomMind
tracks.notes: A calm, sad fantasy theme (the reupload); the much quieter coda is left out so the level stays even.

tracks.title: Washed Up
tracks.creator: HoliznaCC0
tracks.notes: Instrumental lo-fi (album OCEAN MEMORY). Looped on its own beat: 56 bars at 90 BPM, one-beat crossfade.

tracks.title: Currents We Used to Know
tracks.creator: HoliznaCC0
tracks.notes: Instrumental lo-fi (album OCEAN MEMORY). Looped on its own beat (48 bars), one-beat crossfade.

tracks.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
tracks.creator: Erik Satie, played by Robin Alciatore (Musopen)
tracks.notes: The whole piece. The composition (1888) and this recording are both in the public domain; gently compressed so quiet bars stay audible under speech.

tracks.title: Calm Piano 1 (Vaporware)
tracks.creator: The Cynic Project (cynicmusic)
tracks.notes: Relaxing pads with a light piano melody.

tracks.title: Nocturne in B-flat minor, Op. 9 No. 1
tracks.creator: Frédéric Chopin, played by Olga Gurevich (Musopen)
tracks.notes: The whole piece. The composition (1832) and this recording (Musopen's Set Chopin Free) are both in the public domain; gently compressed so quiet bars stay audible under speech.

tracks.title: Moonlight Sonata, first movement
tracks.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven, played by Paul Pitman (Musopen)
tracks.notes: The whole movement (Adagio sostenuto). The composition (1801) and this recording are both in the public domain; Musopen asks, as a courtesy, that its recordings are credited and not sold on their own. Gently compressed.

tracks.title: Pathétique Sonata, Adagio cantabile
tracks.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven, played by Paul Pitman (Musopen)
tracks.notes: The whole second movement. The composition (1798) is in the public domain and this recording is dedicated to it under CC0; gently compressed.

tracks.title: Soft rain on a tile roof
tracks.creator: richwise
tracks.notes: Field recording (Freesound's public preview of the original). Three minutes from before the passing aeroplane; low rumble filtered out.

tracks.title: Brook, stream, flowing water
tracks.creator: TRP
tracks.notes: Field recording of a small stream in a forest, close-miked (Freesound's public preview of the original).

tracks.title: Gentle ocean waves
tracks.creator: esh9419, with recordings by subtyrant and indieground
tracks.notes: Field-recording mix (Freesound's public preview). It includes parts of subtyrant's “Xerokambos beach 01-Sep-11” (freesound.org/people/subtyrant/sounds/132079, CC0 1.0, archived 2025-10-05) and indieground's “Marée basse / Low tide Sables D'Olonne France” (freesound.org/people/indieground/sounds/322139, CC0 1.0, archived 2021-09-18), both checked 2026-10-22. Eight steady minutes from 1:35.

tracks.title: Rain in the forest
tracks.creator: Garuda1982
tracks.notes: Field recording (Freesound's public preview of the original). Eight minutes from 1:55, where the rain is steadiest.

tracks.title: Small stream
tracks.creator: Wildhorsemann
tracks.notes: Field recording of a small stream with a tiny waterfall (Freesound's public preview of the original). Eight minutes from 1:25.
